pages.title: Banded Sea Krait
pages.text: The yellow-lipped sea krait ($(o)Laticauda colubrina$()) lives on the coral reefs and rocky coasts of the eastern Indian Ocean and western Pacific.$(br2)It is bluish grey with evenly spaced black rings, a black head with a bright yellow upper lip and snout, and a flattened, paddle-shaped tail.$(br2)It hunts eels underwater, but returns to land to digest, shed its skin, mate and lay its eggs. Its venom is very strong, but it rarely bites.
